concept.title: Sharing invite links
concept.shortdesc: Click Copy invite link on an interview to create an invite and copy its URL. The link opens a public, mobile-friendly chat page:

ol.li: They chat with the interviewer agent — replies stream in live.
When they're done, the session is complete.

section.title: Emailing an invite
section.p: To have OpenV send the invite for you, click Email invite on an open interview and enter the person's email address. OpenV makes a new invite, names it after the address, and emails them the link with the interview's name and yours. They need no account: the link opens the same chat page.

ul.li: Each address gets its own link, so you can tell the sessions apart.
The email asks them not to forward it: anyone with the link can answer in their place.
If email is not set up on the server, OpenV still makes the invite and shows you the link to send yourself.
Emailing invites counts towards the same hourly allowance as workspace invitations, so a long list may have to wait a little.

section.p: Invite links are token-authenticated and can be revoked: Close an interview and its invite links stop working (you'll be asked to confirm). Closing is permanent — a closed interview can't issue new invites, so create a new interview if you need more sessions.

The interviewer agent needs a runner online to reply — automations-style ownerless routing applies, so a hosted runner keeps interviews responsive even when no one is at their desk (see Runs & runners).
